# Song

Song maker: an original song with vocals, generated from a theme or your own lyrics in the genre and mood you choose.

## What it does
Give the theme or paste your lyrics, pick a genre, mood and voice. Claude tells you the price and creates the song in your account.

**How the files are made:** each song is generated by an audio model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Original songs only; do not ask to imitate a real artist's voice.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install song@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Song talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/song/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each song uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The song plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_song_models` | Models for songs with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_song_cost` | Exact price of one song before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_song` | Starts one song in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_song` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A happy pop birthday song for Anna"
- "A country song about a road trip with my dog"
- "Sing these lyrics as an acoustic ballad"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the song (the theme, your lyrics if you give them, the genre, the mood and the voice) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
